description.to:
Outcome: After every row on the shared stack has a tenant, make tenantId required on every tenant model of the shared schema, so a writer that forgets it fails loudly instead of creating an invisible row. Dedicated stacks follow after their adoption.

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): amplify/data/schema.ts and the function/plugin schema files (tenantId .required() behind the tenancy mode), scripts/test-schema-parity.ts.

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features_backend/tenant-field-required.feature):
Scenario: A write without a tenant fails on the shared stack
    Given the shared stack
    When a client creates a Message with no tenantId
    Then AppSync rejects the input

Dependencies: blocked by PPY-8f9462, PPY-bdc4ee. Blocks nothing in this plan yet. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: -.

Testing: Schema parity; Behave in staging.
Rollout: Shared stack only; after adopt-tenant-data reports zero tenant-less rows.
Risk and mitigation: Risk: a rarely-used writer breaks in production. Mitigation: staging runs every scheduled job for a week with the requirement on before production.

Releasable on its own: no (needs the backfill).
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: unchanged (input validation).
Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR on branch docs/multi-tenant-architecture).
